name: (01) Dark Thaumaturgy (Fires of the Inferno) — 1 Basic — Flash Blind

system.description:
A brief flare of intensely bright hellfire bursts before a victim's eyes, more distraction than wound, but enough to leave them reeling while the infernalist strikes or slips away.

Make a Mental Challenge against your target; on a win they are dazzled and disoriented, automatically losing all ties until the end of the next turn. If the victim was using Heightened Senses to enhance their vision, the sensory overload blinds them for one full hour. As with all Fires of the Inferno, this flame is supernatural, so mundane fire protection and body armor give no defense; range is your line of sight. Retest with Occult.
